scope: Minimal public functional playback status; raw captures remain local.
user_report: DTS works perfectly; the woofer did not play, which is the expected receiver behavior.
mode_evidence: Helper log reports spdif IEC 61937 passthrough for AC-3 and DTS, and locates DTS on private substream 0x88.
passthrough_sample_count_note: IEC 61937 carries the compressed bursts inside the PCM stream, so a non-zero emitted sample count is the burst carrier rather than decoded audio. The standard-MiSTer baseline reports the identical figure.
lfe_note: The receiver did not reproduce DTS LFE, matching entries 621 and 626. Entry 621 measured LFE present in the emitted bursts at 1267.3 RMS, so this is a logged device observation and neither a core limitation nor a Buildroot result.

baseline_comparison.transport_profile_differs: Entry 626 was captured under profile_version=1 credit_fast_v1; this run is profile_version=2 credit_step_v1, so transport-layer timing figures are not comparable.

terminal_pixel_comparison.result: Pixel-identical outside the telemetry overlay rectangle.
